missionControl.pageSubtitle: Live view of AISHA's stack — agents, deploys, drift, rollback, stories, audit.

liveAgents.title: Live agents
liveAgents.subtitle: AISHA runs that are executing right now.
liveAgents.cancelConfirm: Stop "{{agent}}"? This halts the run and is recorded in the audit journal.

audit.title: Audit feed
audit.subtitle: Warnings, errors, and critical events from audit_journal.
audit.empty: No elevated audit entries — quiet system.

agentSessions.title: Agent sessions
agentSessions.subtitle: Live work sessions across IDEs, CLIs and spawned agents.

spendApprovals.title: Spend approvals
spendApprovals.subtitle: Tasks waiting for a cost decision before they start.
spendApprovals.approveConfirm: Allow "{{kind}}" (estimated ~${{estimate}}) to start? The decision is audited.
spendApprovals.raiseBudget: Also raise the story lifetime budget by ${{estimate}}
spendApprovals.rejectConfirm: Cancel "{{kind}}"? The run will not start.

spendPolicies.title: Spend policies
spendPolicies.subtitle: Allow / ask / deny thresholds per task kind. No rule = cost-class defaults.
spendPolicies.empty: No custom rules — catalog defaults apply.
spendPolicies.dialogSubtitle: Thresholds in USD against the pre-flight estimate. Empty field = catalog default.

spawnClaude.title: Spawn a Claude agent run
spawnClaude.description: AISHA starts an isolated Claude Code agent on a fresh worktree for this task. It runs on your subscription and is monitored live below.
spawnClaude.promptPlaceholder: Describe what the agent should do…
spawnClaude.success: Claude run {{id}} queued — it will appear below shortly.

claudeApprovals.title: CLI run approvals
claudeApprovals.subtitle: Agent CLI runs held pending approval (high-risk admission).

resolverPolicy.title: Decision weights
resolverPolicy.subtitle: How AISHA weighs candidates when choosing a model + executor. Tuned live; no code change.
resolverPolicy.missing: No global decision policy — the resolver will fail loud. Re-run cold-start / heals.
resolverPolicy.dialogSubtitle: Global scoring weights + cost-class cutoffs. Empty field keeps the current value.
